test_pl_repeat: test the pl.repeat function to repeat a scalar value n times with eager and lazy modes
test_pl_repeat_expr_input: test the pl.repeat function with expression inputs for both n and value parameters
test_pl_ones: test the pl.ones function to create a series of ones with specified count and dtype
test_pl_zeros: test the pl.zeros function to create a series of zeros with specified count and dtype
test_repeat_by_logical_dtype: test the Series.repeat_by method to repeat elements by counts from another column with logical dtypes
